_comment: Paste your ad network's raw HTML/JS snippet as a string in each slot. Leave empty string to hide a slot. Only standard, clearly-labeled placements are used — no fake-close-button or fake-play-button overlays, since those violate ad network policies (Adsterra/PropellerAds/etc.) and can get your account banned.
_adsEnabled_comment: MASTER SWITCH. Set to false to instantly turn off every ad slot, the global network script, AND the Watch-Now interstitial page site-wide — no code edit needed, just flip this and rebuild/redeploy.

redirectInterstitial._comment: Controls the interstitial page that opens in a NEW TAB when someone clicks Watch Now, before sending them to the real platform. The original site tab stays open on the movie page. If adsEnabled (above) is false, this is skipped entirely regardless of this value.

networkScripts._comment: Global network scripts (e.g. Adsterra 'Social Bar' or PropellerAds push script) that load once site-wide, placed before </body>.

telegramPromo.comment: Popup promoting MoboReels app downloads and short drama code for instant access.
telegramPromo.title: 🎬 Watch Full Drama Episodes in HD!
telegramPromo.message: Download MoboReels app & search code 259PGF to unlock unlimited trending short dramas!

stickyBottomAd._comment: A slim banner ad pinned to the bottom of the screen, always visible while browsing (classic 'sticky footer ad'). Has a small close (×) button — closing hides it only for that page view, standard behavior, not a dark pattern.

periodicTopAd._comment: A banner that slides down from the top every `intervalSeconds`, stays visible for `visibleSeconds`, then slides back up — repeats on a timer instead of appearing once. Good for high-impression placements without covering content permanently.

homeBetweenRows.label: Native/banner ad injected after every 8 movie cards on homepage

sidebar.label: 300x250 sidebar unit on movie detail pages

inArticleTop.label: Ad shown right above the review text

inArticleBottom.label: Ad shown right below the review text, above watch links

beforeWatchButton.label: High-visibility slot just above the real Watch Now buttons (best CTR spot — must stay visually separate from the real buttons)

smartClick.label: Smart Click
smartClick.note: Optional CTA. Leave URL empty to hide. Use only a destination you control or are authorized to promote.

refer.label: Refer & Earn
refer.note: Optional referral link. Leave URL empty to hide.

responsiveAds._note: Recommended lightweight inventory. Use one top slider, one desktop rail per side, one in-content/native unit, and one small mobile sticky. Avoid stacking too many overlays.

contentAds._note: Content editor blocks. Set enabled=true and provide an image + link, or raw code. Keep labels visible and do not make ads look like Watch/Download controls.

adInventoryNotes: Top responsive banner: 728x90 desktop / responsive 320x100 or 320x50 mobile.
Desktop side rail: only show on screens >=1280px; keep each rail around 160x600 or 300x250.
In-content native/banner: place after a meaningful content section, not between navigation and the real Watch button.
Mobile slide: use a small 320x100 or 320x50 unit, delayed and frequency-capped so it does not interrupt reading.
Sticky bottom: keep short, closable, and responsive; do not cover important controls.
Image/link ads: use a clearly labeled Advertisement block with a clickable image.
Avoid multiple simultaneous overlays, fake close buttons, fake player controls, or ads that imitate site navigation.
